$comment: W1.6 licence policy: ONE policy over the npm lockfiles, the browser bundle (licenceModules() in vite.config.ts),
platform-engine/engines.lock.json and the data assets (fonts, ICC profiles). Enforced by scripts/licence-check.mjs
(CI step 'Licence gate' in .github/workflows/ci.yml); notices by scripts/notices.mjs. Licences are SPDX ids.
Browser bundle: MIT, Apache, BSD, ISC, MPL and OFL only. GPL/LGPL: server-only and only from serverCopyleft.
Blocked everywhere: AGPL, SSPL, BUSL, PolyForm, CC-NC, source-available and no-licence code, also when written as
'X WITH <exception>' (Apache-2.0 WITH Commons-Clause): an exception passes only if 'withExceptions' lists it.
A violation found in today's dependencies is never fixed here by changing a dependency: it goes under
'exceptions' as an owner decision with a reason, so CI stays green and the decision stays visible on every run.

browser.$comment: Families: MIT (MIT, MIT-0), Apache (Apache-2.0), BSD (BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, 0BSD), ISC, MPL (MPL-2.0), OFL (OFL-1.1).

server.$comment: Backend image, Workers, the engine image and dev tooling (dev tools use the server rules). The browser list plus other permissive licences with notice-only duties.

blocked.reason: Sustainable Use License: source-available (fair-code), commercial distribution restricted

withExceptions.$comment: The SPDX exceptions allowed after WITH. Each one here was read and only ADDS rights (linking, runtime, font-embedding or generated-output permissions). Any other WITH fails ('exception-not-allowed'), and one that matches 'blocked' fails as blocked: Commons Clause is declared as 'Apache-2.0 WITH Commons-Clause' and takes rights away. The base licence is still judged by its own rules (GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 stays server-only and allowlist-only).

copyleft.$comment: GPL and LGPL (any version, with or without exceptions such as the font exception). Never in the browser; on the server only for the names below. Names are a package's OWN npm name (never the alias key it is installed under), 'engine:<id>' for engines.lock.json entries and 'asset:<name>' for data assets.

serverAllowlist.reason: libvips (LGPL-3.0-or-later) through sharp: prebuilt shared library, server-only, unmodified
sharp's Windows build bundles libvips (LGPL-3.0-or-later); dev machines only
sharp's WebAssembly build bundles libvips (LGPL-3.0-or-later); never loaded in the browser
libvips in the engine image (LGPL), dynamically linked
poppler-utils in the heavy pool, run as a separate process on our own output (GPL)
ffmpeg as a separate process (LGPL/GPL build), server-only

$denyPackages: Matched against an npm package's own name AND any alias it is installed under, and against an engines.lock.json entry as both 'engine:<id>' and the bare '<id>'. An exception never rescues a denied package.

denyPackages.reason: Tiptap Pro: paid, not open source
the original pdf-lib is unmaintained; use the maintained @cantoo/pdf-lib fork

elections.$comment: Dual-licensed packages and the option we use. The elected licence must be one of the OR alternatives.

jszip.reason: jszip is (MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later); we use it under its MIT option

clarifications.$comment: Lockfile licence strings that are not SPDX, mapped after reading the package's licence file. Keyed by name@version so an update is re-read.

duck@0.1.12.evidence: package.json says 'BSD'; node_modules/duck/LICENSE is the 2-clause BSD text (Copyright (c) 2013, Michael Williamson)

@codesandbox/nodebox@0.1.8.evidence: package.json says 'SEE LICENSE IN ./LICENSE'; node_modules/@codesandbox/nodebox/LICENSE is the Sustainable Use License 1.0 (licensor CodeSandBox B.V.): internal or non-commercial use only, free non-commercial distribution only

exceptions.reason: Source-available code in the browser bundle. Pulled in by @codesandbox/sandpack-client <- @codesandbox/sandpack-react (Apache-2.0), the chat code playground (components/chat/ReactPlayground.tsx, MultiFilePlayground.tsx, artifacts/LiveComponentSandbox.tsx), and bundled into the lazy vendor-sandpack chunk that every visitor can download. The Sustainable Use License allows internal or non-commercial use and free non-commercial distribution only. Owner options: alias the Node runtime out of the bundle (only Node templates use it), replace the playground runtime, or accept the risk in writing.

W3C polyfill pulled in by @react-hook/intersection-observer <- @codesandbox/sandpack-react (chat code playground, lazy vendor-sandpack chunk). The W3C Software and Document License is permissive (notice only) but not on the browser list (MIT/Apache/BSD/ISC/MPL/OFL). Owner options: add W3C-20150513 to the browser list, or drop it together with the playground.

Data asset served to every browser: public/models/yamnet/yamnet-v1.onnx, used by the baby monitor's camera device (live/monitor/yamnet.worker.ts, live/monitor/soundClasses.ts). The weights are Apache-2.0, but per public/models/yamnet/README.md the AudioSet labels it classifies into are CC BY 4.0, which is attribution-only yet not on the browser list (MIT/Apache/BSD/ISC/MPL/OFL). The attribution is printed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. Owner options: allow CC-BY-4.0 for browser data assets (attribution kept in the notices), or remove the model and the monitor's sound detection.

Data asset served to every browser: public/models/mediapipe/efficientdet_lite0-int8-v1.tflite, used by the baby monitor's smart vision (live/monitor/sceneAi.ts). The model is Apache-2.0, but per public/models/mediapipe/README.md its COCO labels are CC BY 4.0, which is attribution-only yet not on the browser list (MIT/Apache/BSD/ISC/MPL/OFL). The attribution is printed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. Owner options: allow CC-BY-4.0 for browser data assets (attribution kept in the notices), or remove the object detector (smart vision keeps the pose model).

$lockfiles: The lockfiles below are always read; every other package-lock.json under the app (outside node_modules, build output and test fixtures) is found and read too, with the server rules unless its packages are in the browser bundle.

vendored.$comment: Third-party code copied into the repo. Every directory directly under a folder named 'vendor' needs a record here and must keep its licence file and a PATCHES.md next to the code.

engines.$lockfiles: Only the files listed here are read; each engine is judged by the server rules under the name engine:<id>.
engines.$npmLockfile: The engine image's own npm runtime (sharp with libvips, the document libraries). The gate judges it like every other package-lock.json (it is in 'lockfiles' above); `node scripts/notices.mjs --engines` lists its non-dev packages in the image's /licenses, with the texts read from platform-engine/node_modules.
engines.$comment: Every engine binary that enters the platform-engine image: pinned by sha256, with its licence and source URL. Evaluated with the server rules under the name 'engine:<id>'; the denylist also sees the bare id, and dataAssets.minVersions applies to the id (case-insensitive). The schema is a JSON Schema subset (type, const, enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, pattern, minLength, maxLength, maxItems).

dataAssets.$comment: Every font, ICC profile and model file (ONNX, TFLite, MediaPipe .task, RTen) in the repo (outside node_modules and build output) must match exactly one record with its licence, its terms (what we may do with it) and the licence text file. Scope browser = served to browsers (listed in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt); server = backend image; engine = platform-engine image (listed in its /licenses); qa = the QA harness build (dist-qa), checked with the browser rules. No OCR model (*.rten, *.onnx) may enter the engine image (plan section 11): never add an engine-scope record for one.

customLicences.$comment: LicenseRef-* terms a data asset may carry (an ICC profile's licence, say), keyed by id: { terms, licenceText, scopes, verified }. 'verified' becomes true only after a human read the licence text; until then any record using it fails.

dataAssets.$minVersions: Version pins, matched case-insensitively against data-asset record names AND engines.lock.json ids (an engine 'fonts-liberation' or 'liberation-fonts' 1.07.4 fails). A matching record or engine below 'min', or without a version, fails as 'asset-version'.

minVersions.name: (^|[^A-Za-z])Liberation
minVersions.reason: Liberation fonts 1.x are GPL-2.0 with a font exception; 2.x is OFL-1.1

records.name: YAMNet sound model
records.terms: Weights: Apache License 2.0, Copyright 2022 Google LLC (google/yamnet v1 as the ONNX export published at huggingface.co/audiomagic/yamnet-onnx, weights unchanged). Served unmodified to the baby monitor's camera device and run in the browser; live/monitor/yamnet.worker.ts checks its SHA-256 before it runs. Its 521 output classes are the AudioSet ontology, whose labels are CC BY 4.0 (public/models/yamnet/README.md): attribution 'AudioSet ontology by Google, licensed under CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/'.

Served unmodified to the baby monitor's camera device and run in the browser by live/monitor/sceneAi.ts, which checks its SHA-256. Its 80 class labels are the COCO labels, CC BY 4.0 (public/models/mediapipe/README.md): attribution 'COCO dataset labels by the COCO Consortium, licensed under CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/'.

records.name: MediaPipe pose landmarker (lite)
records.terms: Google MediaPipe Tasks model (BlazePose lite, 33 landmarks, float16), Apache License 2.0, Google LLC. Served unmodified to the baby monitor's camera device and run in the browser by live/monitor/sceneAi.ts, which checks its SHA-256.
